4. Top Planform & Rotor Geometry Rotor Ø: 14.63 m
  • • Main Rotor Blades: Cambered airfoil blades, titanium leading-edge sheaths, swept tips & twin root cuff pins
  • • Upper Deck Details: Cross-braced canopy roof, 18 exhaust louver slats & weathered olive/rust camo
